name: Snow toast
description: Notifications that drift down from the top of the window like large flakes, settle on a pile at the bottom, and melt when dismissed.

props.name: snowToast(message, options?)
props.description: Lets a message fall onto the pile and returns its id. Call it from anywhere, inside React or not. It is announced politely.

props.name: snowToast.dismiss(id?)
props.description: Melts one message, or all of them when called without an id.

props.name: options.title
props.description: The message, when passing options as the first argument.

props.name: options.description
props.description: A line or two under the title.

props.name: options.icon
props.description: An 18 pixel icon before the title, drawn in water blue.

props.name: options.action
props.description: A small button, e.g. Undo. Pressing it also melts the message.

props.name: options.duration
props.description: Milliseconds it rests on the pile before melting, counted from when it lands. Infinity keeps it until dismissed. Defaults to the toaster's duration.

props.name: options.id
props.description: Reuse an id to update a message in place.

props.name: options.onDismiss
props.description: Called when the message starts to melt, by time, button or keyboard.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the pile gathers. Messages always fall from the top of the window. Mount one per app.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default milliseconds before a message melts. Timers pause while the pile is hovered or focused, and while the tab is hidden.

props.name: visibleToasts
props.description: Most messages on the pile. When another lands, the oldest at the bottom melts.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between messages on the pile.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the edges of the window.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the region. Alt+T moves focus to the newest message; Escape or Delete melts the focused one.
